scope: External reference screenshots only. No local application verification or fidelity claim.
data: Only the supplied prototype fake learner Maya Chen and its built-in scenarios. No real learner data or provider calls.
method: Read version-matched Orca browser guide. Operated only the dedicated external reference page.

Snapshot after every UI-state change. Native DOM button activation used after pointer clicks did not activate controls; no React internals, app data injection, CSS changes, artifact edits or publishing.
Mobile: documented iPhone 12 emulation; innerWidth=390, innerHeight=844, devicePixelRatio=3 confirmed.

Desktop: host browser zoom produced incorrect CSS dimensions from nominal viewport. Compensated using documented set viewport 1000 625 1.44; verified innerWidth=1440, innerHeight=900, devicePixelRatio approximately 1; PNG dimensions 1440x900. Native scrollbar yields visualViewport.width approximately 1418.4.

Theme selected through supplied Prototype controls. html[data-theme] verified; root class remains light in both themes. Dark body background rgb(18,20,23); source interviewer teal bubbles remain light in dark theme.
Screenshots decoded from Orca JSON result.data directly to PNG; base64 was not printed. Prior reference files are retained as historical captures and do not gain verified matching geometry.
limitations: Reference contains prototype-only controls and shell excluded from production implementation by recorded authority.
These are viewport captures; they do not establish visibility of every lower form control or every source state.
Desktop matched captures use 1440x900 CSS pixels, not 1440x1000, because 900 is exactly representable through the reference host zoom without changing page CSS.

Mobile preview PNG compositor corruption: interview-preview-mobile.png repeats fixed header/transcript layers and omits part of sheet body. The full-screenshot attempt repeats the same layers. Neither image supports full-body pixel comparison; use interview-preview-mobile-dom.json and .txt for actual rendered geometry/control evidence, alongside the clean guarded local runtime screenshot.
